correctness.rationale: The local majority map and incumbent tie rule define 16/256-column finite transfer matrices. Exact integer SCC/Newton determinant and Cayley–Hamilton numerator checks were executed on verification/transfer_certificate.py through the full 16/256 dimensions, proving the full all-length rational identity. An independent direct binary update enumerator verifies n=3 through 9. Quadratic polynomial congruences establish golden pole residues; a symmetric energy argument proves eventual periods divide two. The proposition makes no basin or unrelated graph claim.

originality.rationale: The missing-rung minority fixed-state publication gives the same equilibrium amplification and, through even-prism bipartite conjugacy, covers the even-circumference majority fixed subcase; these are explicitly excluded as standalone novelty. The remaining majority odd correction and especially its exact 256-state two-step return generating function and opposite response coefficient were not found in the inspected published baseline, general transfer literature or published defect study. Priority remains qualified by inaccessible/unindexed equivalent work.
residual_risks: General transfer methods algorithmically cover construction of local matrices; novelty is the evaluated nonroutine exact numerator and complementary response, not that technique.
The minority-defect paper already covers an exact even-circumference majority fixed-point subcase by bipartite switching, and the common 3/sqrt5 amplification; these are cited as prior results.
Full original Goles–Olivos article and full arXiv 2014 text were not materially inspected, though their accessible scopes do not present an exact rung-defect spectrum.
A nonindexed or earlier publication with the same exact period-two defect polynomial cannot be definitively excluded.

value.rationale: One missing rung is a canonical minimal edge failure on a standard cubic strip. Its exact time-two recurrence differs structurally from intact and path ladders, but has unchanged growth base and a sharp golden coefficient exactly counterbalancing the equilibrium response. The complete all-size period-two rational census and even/odd switching boundary are mathematically motivated invariants, rather than arbitrary isolated parameters.
